requirements.text: During the immunity tests, the ESA under test shall be switched on and shall be stimulated to be in normal operation condition.
requirements.quote: The ESA under test shall be switched on and shall be stimulated to be in normal operation condition.
atomic: During the immunity tests, the ESA under test shall be switched on.
During the immunity tests, the ESA under test shall be stimulated to be in normal operation condition.

requirements.text: During the immunity tests, the ESA under test shall be arranged as defined in this Annex unless individual test methods dictate otherwise.
requirements.quote: It shall be arranged as defined in this Annex unless individual test methods dictate otherwise.

requirements.text: The ESA immunity measurements shall be made in the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency range with frequency steps according to ISO 11452-1.
requirements.quote: Measurements shall be made in the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency range with frequency steps according to ISO 11452-1.

requirements.text: If not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer, the test signal modulation shall be AM (amplitude modulation), with 1 kHz modulation and 80 per cent modulation depth in the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range.
requirements.quote: (a) AM (amplitude modulation), with 1 kHz modulation and 80 per cent modulation depth in the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range;
atomic: If not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer, the test signal modulation in the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range shall be AM (amplitude modulation).
If not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer, the AM test signal in the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range shall have 1 kHz modulation.
If not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer, the AM test signal in the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range shall have 80 per cent modulation depth.

requirements.text: If not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer, the test signal modulation shall be PM2 (pulse modulation type 2), Ton 3 µs, period 3,333 µs in the 2,700 to 3,100 MHz frequency range.
requirements.quote: (b) PM2 (pulse modulation type 2), Ton 3 µs, period 3,333 µs in the 2,700 to 3,100 MHz frequency range;
atomic: If not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer, the test signal modulation in the 2,700 to 3,100 MHz frequency range shall be PM2 (pulse modulation type 2).
If not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer, the PM2 test signal in the 2,700 to 3,100 MHz frequency range shall have Ton 3 µs.
If not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer, the PM2 test signal in the 2,700 to 3,100 MHz frequency range shall have a period of 3,333 µs.

requirements.text: If not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer, the test signal modulation shall be PM3 (pulse modulation type 3), Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs in the 380 to 2,700 MHz and the 3,100 to 6,000 MHz frequency ranges.
requirements.quote: (c) PM3 (pulse modulation type 3), Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs in the 380 to 2,700 MHz and the 3,100 to 6,000 MHz frequency ranges.
atomic: If not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer, the test signal modulation in the 380 to 2,700 MHz frequency range shall be PM3 (pulse modulation type 3), Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs.

If not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer, the test signal modulation in the 3,100 to 6,000 MHz frequency range shall be PM3 (pulse modulation type 3), Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs.

requirements.text: The frequency step size and dwell time shall be chosen according to ISO 11452-1.
requirements.quote: Frequency step size and dwell time shall be chosen according to ISO 11452-1.
atomic: The frequency step size shall be chosen according to ISO 11452-1.
The dwell time shall be chosen according to ISO 11452-1.

requirements.text: The ESA bulk current injection test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-4 on a test bench using either the BCI test method with substitution method and injection probe positioned at 150 mm distance to the ESA, or the BCI test method with closed loop method and injection probe positioned at 900 mm distance to the ESA.
requirements.quote: The test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-4 on a test bench with the following characteristics: BCI test method with substitution method and injection probe positioned at 150 mm distance to the ESA;Or BCI test method with closed loop method and injection probe positioned at 900 mm distance to the ESA.
atomic: Where the substitution method is used, the ESA bulk current injection test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-4 on a test bench with the injection probe positioned at 150 mm distance to the ESA.

Where the closed loop method is used, the ESA bulk current injection test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-4 on a test bench with the injection probe positioned at 900 mm distance to the ESA.

requirements.text: As an alternative, the ESA may be tested while installed in the vehicle according to ISO 11451-4 only with the BCI test method with substitution method and injection probe positioned at 150 mm distance to the ESA.
requirements.quote: As an alternative the ESA may be tested while installed in the vehicle according to ISO 11451-4 with the following characteristics: BCI test method with substitution method and injection probe positioned at 150 mm distance to the ESA.

requirements.text: For immunity against transient disturbances conducted along 12/24 V supply lines, the test pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 shall be applied to the supply lines as well as to other connections of the ESA which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
requirements.quote: Apply the test pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 to the supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
atomic: For immunity against transient disturbances conducted along 12/24 V supply lines, the test pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b according to ISO 7637-2 shall be applied to the supply lines of the ESA.

For immunity against transient disturbances conducted along 12/24 V supply lines, the test pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b according to ISO 7637-2 shall be applied to other connections of the ESA which may be operationally connected to supply lines.

requirements.text: For immunity against transient disturbances conducted along 12/24 V supply lines, the starting profile according to the International Standard ISO 16750-2 shall be applied to the supply lines as well as to other connections of the ESA which may be operationally connected to supply lines, except that ESAs that are exclusively reserved for mounting on electric vehicles (vehicles without 12V/24V starter motor) are not subject to starting profile.
requirements.quote: Apply the starting profile according to the International Standard ISO 16750-2 to the supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines. ESAs that are exclusively reserved for mounting on electric vehicles (vehicles without 12V/24V starter motor) are not subject to starting profile.
atomic: Where the ESA is not exclusively reserved for mounting on electric vehicles, the starting profile according to ISO 16750-2 shall be applied to the supply lines of the ESA.

Where the ESA is not exclusively reserved for mounting on electric vehicles, the starting profile according to ISO 16750-2 shall be applied to other connections of the ESA which may be operationally connected to supply lines.

requirements.text: The emission of transient conducted disturbances generated by the ESA on 12/24 V supply lines shall be measured according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 on supply lines as well as on other connections of the ESA which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
requirements.quote: Measurement according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 on supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
atomic: The emission of transient conducted disturbances generated by the ESA shall be measured according to ISO 7637-2 on the 12/24 V supply lines.
The emission of transient conducted disturbances generated by the ESA shall be measured according to ISO 7637-2 on other connections of the ESA which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
